facts.text: I am trying to recreate a Bloody Mary recipe I had at a hotel bar in Miami last month.
I want tips on how to make a spicy mix for a Bloody Mary.
I took a cocktail-making class a few weeks ago.
I learned how to make a classic Cosmopolitan in the cocktail-making class.
I want to know the best way to store the spicy mix once it's made.
I want to know how long the spicy mix typically lasts in the fridge.
I am experimenting with different types of ice in my cocktails.
I found that crushed ice makes a big difference in the flavor and texture of my cocktails.
I am thinking of trying new recipes that incorporate fresh herbs.
I want recommendations for herbs that pair well with vodka or triple sec.
I am hosting a dinner party soon.
I want to create a unique cocktail for the dinner party using some of the fresh herbs I have been experimenting with.
I chose the Cucumber Basil Refresher as my cocktail.
I want suggestions for appetizers or small bites that pair well with the Cucumber Basil Refresher.
I chose the Grilled Peach and Prosciutto Bruschetta as an appetizer.
I believe the sweetness of the peaches and the salty prosciutto will complement the refreshing flavors of the Cucumber Basil Refresher.
